text.heading: Biometeorološka prognoza za Srbiju za: 19.11.2026. - ČETVRTAK
text.body: Nepovolјna biometeorološka situacija može doprineti značajnom pojačanju tegoba kod osoba sa kardio vaskularnim obolјenjima, kao i kod astmatičara i reumatičara. Osetlјive osobe mogu imati meteoropatske reakcije u vidu razdražlјivosti, pospanosti i bolova u kostima i zglobovima. U saobraćaju je neophodan naročit oprez.

english.heading: Biometeorological forecast: 19.11.2026. - THURSDAY
english.body: Unfavorable biometeorological conditions may lead to a significant intensification of symptoms in individuals with cardiovascular diseases, as well as in those suffering from asthma or rheumatic conditions. Sensitive individuals may experience weather-related reactions, such as irritability, drowsiness, and pain in the bones and joints. Extra caution is advised in traffic.

text.heading: Biometeorološka prognoza za Srbiju za: 20.11.2026. - PETAK
text.body: Biometeorološka situacija može imati nepovolјan uticaj na većinu hronično obolelih. Poseban oprez se savetuje osobama sa varirajućim krvnim pritiskom i respiratornim obolјenjima. Pospanost, bolovi u kostima i razdražlјivost su moguće meteoropatske reakcije. Preporučuje se adekvatno odevanje u skladu sa očekivanim termičkim uslovima. Neophodna je povećana pažnja u saobraćaju.

english.heading: Biometeorological forecast: 20.11.2026. - FRIDAY
english.body: Biometeorological situation may have unfavourable influence on the majority of chronically sick. Special caution is advised to persons suffering from fluctuating blood pressure and respiratory problems. Sleepiness, bone pains and irritability are among the possible meteoropathic reactions. Everyone is recommended to dress in accordance with the thermal condition. Additional attention in the traffic is needed.

products.noteSr: Dnevna očitavanja u terminu navedenom u izvornom izveštaju. Ovo je odvojen proizvod od automatskih stanica. Proticaj u m³/s; vodostaj i dnevna promena u cm.
products.noteEn: Daily readings at the source report time. This product is separate from automatic stations. Discharge is in m³/s; stage and daily change are in cm.

products.noteEn: The first date is an observation, followed by four forecast days. Defence thresholds are reference values; this view does not declare a flood defence state.

products.noteSr: Originalni radarski kompozit. dBZ označava radarsku reflektivnost, a ne količinu padavina u milimetrima. Termine čitamo iz izvornih naziva datoteka u UTC. Slike se učitavaju direktno sa RHMZ-a.

text.heading: Meteorološka i hidrološka upozorenja
text.body: UPOZORENJA RHMZ Meteorološko upozorenje ČETVRTAK, 19.11.2026. u 09:10 h UPOZORENJE ZA PODRUČJE SRBIJE NA OLUJNE I ORKANSKE UDARE VETRA TOKOM VEČERI (za 19.11.2026.godine) Tokom večeri u zoni hladnog fronta, koji će se premeštati u zapadnoj visinskoj struji, očekuju se olujni i orkanski udari zapadnog i severozapadnog vetra. Na području Vojvodine, zapadne i centralne Srbije, kao i na području Beograda, prognoziraju se udari vetra od 80 do 110 km/h. UPOZORENJE ZA PODRUČJE BEOGRADA NA OLUJNE UDARE VETRA TOKOM VEČERI (za 19.11.2026.godine) Tokom večeri očekuju se olujni, kratkotrajno i orkanski udari zapadnog i severozapadnog vetra, od 80 do 110 km/h. Upozorenje je za period od: 09:07 19.11.2026. do: 09:07 20.11.2026. Hidrološko upozorenje Na Dunavu od Bezdana do Slankamena i na Tisi kod Titela narednih dana vodostaji će se kretati ispod niskih plovidbenih nivoa. Za više detalja pogledajte: Prognoza voda Upozorenje je za period od: 11:31 18.11.2026. do: 11:31 20.11.2026. RHMZ Srbije 19.11.2026 Trenutno nema aktuelnog agrometeorološkog upozorenja. RHMZ Srbije 19.11.2026 Trenutno nema vanredne agrometeorološke informacije.

english.heading: Weather and hydrological warnings
english.body: The RHMZ warning issued on 19 November at 09:10 concerns strong wind during the evening of 19 November. Storm-force and hurricane-force gusts of westerly and northwesterly wind are forecast along a cold front moving in the upper-level westerly flow. Gusts of 80–110 km/h are forecast in Vojvodina, western and central Serbia, and Belgrade. The Belgrade warning specifies storm-force gusts, briefly reaching hurricane force, of 80–110 km/h. The published weather-warning period is 19 November at 09:07 to 20 November at 09:07, Europe/Belgrade. The separate hydrological warning says water levels on the Danube from Bezdan to Slankamen and on the Tisa at Titel are expected to remain below low navigation levels in the coming days; its published period is 18 November at 11:31 to 20 November at 11:31. The retrieved source also states that there is no current agrometeorological warning or extraordinary agrometeorological information as of 19 November. These are statements in the retrieved edition; check RHMZ for the current status.

text.heading: Meteorološke najave
text.body: NAJAVE RHMZ Meteorološka najava ČETVRTAK, 19.11.2026. u 11:35 h POSLE PODNE NOVO NAOBLAČENJE SA KIŠOM SA ZAPADA, A UVEČE I OLUJNI UDARI VETRA Posle podne i uveče oblačno, mestimično sa kišom i lokalnim plјuskovima uz skretanje vetra na umeren i jak zapadni i severozapadni. Uveče na području Vojvodine, zapadne i centralne Srbije, kao i na području Beograda udari vetra će biti olujni, ponegde i orkanski, od 80 do 110 km/h. U toku noći ka petku prestanak padavina i razvedravanje, UZ SLABLјENJE VETRA. ČESTA PROLAZNA NAOBLAČENJA SA KIŠOM, OD SUBOTE POSTEPEN PAD TEMPERATURE Narednih dana promenlјivo, povremeno sa kišom i lokalnim plјuskovima. U petak toplo sa maksimalnom temperaturom u većini mesta od 16 do 20 °S, a od subote temperatura u postepenom padu. Najava je za period od: 11:38 19.11.2026. do: 11:38 26.11.2026. Hidrološka najava Na Savi narednih dana vodostaji će biti u većem porastu bez dostizanja granica redovne odbrane od poplava. Za više detalja pogledajte: Prognoza voda Najava je za period od: 11:31 18.11.2026. do: 11:31 20.11.2026.

english.heading: Weather and hydrological advisories
english.body: RHMZ advisory issued on 19 November at 11:35: cloud and rain spread from the west during the afternoon and evening, with local showers and winds turning moderate to strong westerly and northwesterly. Evening gusts in Vojvodina, western and central Serbia, and Belgrade may reach storm force and locally hurricane force, at 80–110 km/h. Rain stops and skies clear overnight into Friday, with weakening winds. The following days remain changeable, with occasional rain and local showers. Friday stays warm, with maxima of 16–20 °C in most places; temperatures gradually fall from Saturday. The published weather-advisory period is 19 November at 11:38 to 26 November at 11:38, Europe/Belgrade. The separate hydrological advisory forecasts a substantial rise of the Sava in the coming days without reaching regular flood-defence thresholds; its published period is 18 November at 11:31 to 20 November at 11:31. Check RHMZ for the current status.

english.heading: Urgent warnings
english.body: The urgent RHMZ report dated 19 November at 09:50 states that very strong wind gusts exceeding 100 km/h are expected in Vojvodina and Belgrade during the evening. RHMZ has activated the system for sending urgent SMS information to citizens. The report advises people to remain alert and informed, and refers to the public emergency-information platform, Meteoalarm, animated radar imagery and Meteoalarm advice for further information. The published warning period is 19 November at 09:56 to 20 November at 09:56, Europe/Belgrade. This is a summary of the retrieved report, not confirmation of the current operational status; check the official source.
